rules.description: Ensure active currencies (EUR, INR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY) have MaxDate at or after 2025 to catch import stagnation.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar LIKE '%_ToCurrency_EUR' OR StatVar LIKE '%_ToCurrency_INR' OR StatVar LIKE '%_ToCurrency_GBP' OR StatVar LIKE '%_ToCurrency_JPY' OR StatVar LIKE '%_ToCurrency_CAD' OR StatVar LIKE '%_ToCurrency_AUD' OR StatVar LIKE '%_ToCurrency_CHF' OR StatVar LIKE '%_ToCurrency_CNY'

rules.description: Verifies the generated output CSV data matches established critical golden records
